experimental.description: Experimental technology: not yet standardized (proposed or draft; subject to change or removal).

obsolete.description: Obsolete or alternative elements: removed from the spec entirely. Optionally points to an alternative element via `alt`.

deprecated.description: Deprecated: still defined by the spec but its use is discouraged.

nonStandard.description: Non-standard: never part of any standard (vendor-specific or proprietary).
